failure: Initial adapter assumed every group report was an object with components; V-VIII report was a direct list. Dependent setup commands also stopped due to missing output.
resolution: Normalize list and object report shapes explicitly; require successful setup before assembly. No source or scientific payload changed.

failure: Duplicate-object merging (PyMuPDF garbage=3) spent several minutes before emitting output. The incomplete zero-byte PDF was deliberately interrupted with the running-session control. A cross-namespace PID kill attempt found no process; a first whitespace-mismatched source patch did not apply.
resolution: Use garbage=2 (remove unused objects and compact cross-references) with compression, avoiding quadratic duplicate-object merging. All vector content and links retained; final audit is required.

failure: Duplicate part-opening folios and named PDF destinations with a different coordinate convention were detected before the completed book.
resolution: Remove outer duplicate part folios; transform bottom-left named PDF destinations to top-left page coordinates before global mapping. Frozen numeric routes target the exact original attached editions.

failure: The first all-page audit found 83 otherwise valid internal links whose page-origin destination moved to x=-6 after mirrored gutter translation.
resolution: Clamp transformed navigation destination points to the physical book page. Reassemble the complete book and rerun the independent audit. Content geometry is unchanged.

failure: The first audit did not accept valid compact GoToE arrays such as [5/Fit], and treated empty-path sentinel bounding boxes as visible graphics.
resolution: Retain the initial failed report and audit code; correct these two representation predicates without weakening destination range, text survival, full-page frame, attachment identity or visible geometry checks. Audit the new PDF hash.

failure: I-IV source builds depended on a local fonts/ folder intentionally excluded from the deliverable.
resolution: Restore 60 font placements from 27 explicitly selected installed fonts with exact SHA-256 checks. A fresh empty-directory preparation test passed and an intentionally incorrect hash was rejected; 339 TeX/style/compiled-PDF files remained byte-identical. See source_i_iv/FONT_PREPARATION_VALIDATION.json and editorial/REBUILD_PORTABILITY_REVIEW.json.

failure: The initial packaging invocation supplied a positional root argument that the unchanged strict verifier does not accept; it exited before checking the stage.
resolution: Call the verifier at its staged path with --strict. It derives the package root from its own location. Correct the README command as well; preserve verifier bytes and inherited control provenance.
